title: No jump cuts
text: No jump cuts: in studio picture cut only at a thought end or a camera change. Cut hard (stumbles, pauses, repeats) only under a cover. (Status note, user 2026-11-23: rule 5 now allows inset camera changes and cuts under a still, and a punch-in needs a cover.)
